name: Monica Brown
source:
Monica is a civilian reporter who works for a major broadcast network that somehow managed to get a clearance to record from inside the moon base, despite the fact that most of the activity there is highly classified. She has a dual personality. Monica is aggressive and vulgar while wearing the goggles for her 3-D camera, and on the opposite - shy and unsure without them. Even with her limited access to the facilities as a civilian, few people would seriously consider her to be capable of sabotage. But [url=https://vndb.org/c14801]Captain Leiji[/url] will keep an eye on her nevertheless.

[Edited from [url=http://engbishoujo.tripod.com/criticalprofiles.html]Game's Manual[/url] and [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/562753-critical-point/faqs/19503]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
